method: Complete current-phase compact records plus selected complete original E30 members. No inherited session_records counted as new episodes.

material_traversal.measurement: First outbound base-projection passage from the west to east strip boundary without a side exit, with actual material-loaded feet during that passage. Uses original strip geometry and500Hz recorded states; no extra physical termination threshold or route change.

normalization.finite_task_channels: Always zero for every R11 training and evaluation duration

observer.sampling: Actual elapsed 2 ms; endpoint kinematic boundary. Within-window load/unload is not resolved at 0.2 ms; no true q/e correction.

legal_route.criterion: Original base strip x[.8,2.2],abs(y)<=.6 and actual interior-foot Fz>0 at500Hz; return uses reversed boundaries. Signed credit is provisional and retracted on illegal/incomplete passage. New R12 mission evaluation also checks these recorded legal roundtrips.
